not_found: Rider sag / race sag: not stated in either 99888 spec document or either 2026 owner's manual (searched all pages of both manuals; no 'sag' text). Kawasaki specifies rear setup by preload adjusting-nut position instead.
Separate front vs rear tire pressures: the manuals give one 'Tire Air Pressure Adjustable Range' for both wheels; there is no separate front/rear value and no single 'standard' pressure.
Fork oil level (air-gap measurement in the outer tube): not given. Outer-tube oil is specified by volume (mL); the only 'Oil Level' spec is the cylinder-unit level, 121 – 129 mm.

Suspension values in the 99888 documents: these documents carry only the dimensional/engine/capacity table. All clicker, spring and preload values come from the owner's manuals 99814-0119 / 99814-0121.
Torque values: the 99888 documents contain no torque table. The owner's manuals list torques inline in procedures; these were not systematically extracted here.

Explicit KX250X / KX450X naming: the Kawasaki documents use only model codes (KX252F, KX450N). The mapping to KX250X / KX450X is based on dimensions matching kawasaki.com 2026 spec sheets (see model_mapping_basis). KX450P is a third variant in the same documents and is not mapped to a 2026 US model.
